messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx (≈6.8%) and p99 latency (~1.7s) for /v1/generate in az1a. Started ~2026-03-17T03:12:15Z. Automatic mitigation triggered: local fallback model and circuit breaker. See alert INC-3067899997 and runbook https://runbooks/internal/az1a-network-issue

anne-oncall: acked, I'm paged and taking lead. jumping into logs and metric dashboards now.

raj-sre: I'm online. quick telemetry: NLB targets for inference-backend in az1a are flapping, health check errors mostly TCP reset/timeouts. Checking host syslogs and ENI counters. Running tcpdump on one affected host.

dana-engr: Observed symptom: resolver timeouts from sidecars to local DNS 10.0.5.2 and intermittent ENI TX errors on kernel. Proposed immediate steps: 1) stop L7 connection reuse (disable keepalive) for az1a proxies 2) limit new connections to healthy targets 3) start gradual regional shift to eu1a. Will run commands now.

kevin-support: Customers: two flagged high-priority orgs reporting errors since ~03:14 UTC (tickets T-7900, T-7901). Notified them we're investigating and routing some traffic out of az1a.

raj-sre: Proxy logs: `2026-03-17T03:13:05Z PROXY ERROR dns_lookup: timeout to 10.0.5.2` and host kernel: `tx_errors: 42 rx_errors: 0` on eni0. Looks like ENI/transmit failures + resolver timeouts.

anne-oncall: Executing mitigations: disabling keepalive on proxy for az1a: `kubectl patch configmap proxy-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"keepalive":"off"}}'` and enabling fallback header for SDK: `service-config set inference.client_retry=2 --scope=az1a`. Also starting traffic shift 30% -> eu1a: `infractl route shift --svc inference --from az1a --to eu1a --percent 30`

dana-engr: Also enabling long-term fallback for affected AZ routes to variant-small to reduce per-token resource pressure: `service-config set inference.fallback_model=variant-small --scope=availability-zone/az1a`

raj-sre: After the 30% shift + keepalive toggle + fallback, 5xx dropped ~6.8% -> ~2.8% within 6 minutes, p99 down to ~1.2s. Still seeing ENI tx_errors on a subset of hosts. Will collect ENI counters and open AWS support case.

ops-lead: Status update: impact limited to az1a, partial 5xx for some customers, mitigations applied (proxy keepalive off, fallback model, 30% traffic shift, host investigation). No cross-region evacuation needed yet. Preparing handoff to night team in ~20m.

emma-ops: incoming oncall at 03:40 UTC. please handoff summary and outstanding items I should own.

anne-oncall: @emma-ops summary: alert at 03:12 UTC; root cause suspected local DNS/resolver timeouts and ENI transmit errors causing target flapping. Actions done: fallback model, keepalive disabled, 30% shift to eu1a, tcpdump + ENI metrics collection, customers notified. Outstanding: escalate to AWS with ENI counters and tcpdump, continue traffic shift to 60% if 5xx stays <1.5% for two datapoints, coordinate node drains if host-level NIC issues persist. Postmortem owner: raj-sre.

raj-sre: I'll open AWS support case now (tag aws-engage) and attach ENI metrics + tcpdump. Also will capture `ethtool -S` and `dmesg` for affected hosts.

kevin-support: I'll send a customer update at 03:45 UTC with current mitigation summary and ETA for next update.

emma-ops: taking over. I'll increase shift to 60% to eu1a now: `infractl route shift --svc inference --from az1a --to eu1a --percent 60` and will monitor for regressions. If 5xx rises >1% revert by 15% steps.

incident-bot: NOTE: INC-3067899997 created and linked to PagerDuty. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/inference/az1a.

emma-ops: after moving to 60% traffic: metrics @03:50 UTC: 5xx 0.7%, p99 0.95s. continuing monitoring. If ENI tx_errors persist on hosts, we'll schedule rolling replacement for affected ephemerals and escalate further.

ops-lead: Good progress. Owners: raj-sre -> postmortem + cloud escalation, anne-oncall -> follow customer comms, emma-ops -> mitigation/handoff. Keep updates every 15m until stable.

emma-ops: will update at 04:05 UTC or on any regression. closing interim update. :white_check_mark:
